description: Legal consent layout: scrollable terms of service text on left with consent checkbox action box on right.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Legal Consent Review: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
